title: Spooky Yoga "Special" Edition
description: Lifted Spiritss and Thee Hemp Co in Allentown are at it again for another collab; this time SPOOKY & SPECIAL EDITION STYLE for the crowd!
long_description:
Lifted Spiritss and Thee Hemp Co in Allentown are at it again for another collab; this time SPOOKY & SPECIAL EDITION STYLE for the crowd!

About this Event

Two worlds collide again and we are inviting you in for an afternoon of special fun; Lifted Spiritss & Thee Hemp Co style!!

Meet n mingle from 11am-12pm with those "special" goodies from the host for you to sip and snack on before we start our session! This is a costume party as well, so wear your BEST and we will all giggle & decide the winner. The winner will receive more goodies from Lifted Spiriss and Thee Hemp Co!

From 12-1pm you can expect a beginner friendly slow stretch to warm up, followed by a halloween themed yoga flow that will be slow enough to enjoy, and sure to bring the giggles and fun! Yoga led by Erin Scherer of Lifted Spiritss, but throw a little HALLOWEEN twist in to the flow!
Then relax and enjoy 30-40 minutes of sound bathing fully immersive!

No pressure to perform. No expectations of perfection. Just some good old fun while moving our bodies and lifting our spirits and souls!

Bring your own yoga mat and water. Limited to 10 participants. $36 per person
Located at 604 E Warrington Ave, Pittsburgh PA 15210

Also check out other in Pittsburgh, Health & Wellness events in Pittsburgh.
